title: Rust Glancer: Rust LSP using 100x less RAM
summary: Rust Glancer is an experimental lightweight implementation of the Rust Language Server Protocol that achieves approximately 100x reduction in RAM usage compared to traditional LSP servers like rust-analyzer, making it suitable for resource-constrained environments and large codebases.
problem_solved: Traditional Rust LSP servers consume excessive memory, making IDE performance sluggish especially on larger codebases.
why_valuable: By reducing memory footprint by 100x, it enables smooth IDE experiences on resource-limited systems and makes LSP viable in contexts where it previously wasn't practical.
